top_signals.title: Crop Markets Mixed as Dry Weather Helps Speed US Soybean Harvest
top_signals.summary: Grain and oilseeds were mixed Monday as weather helped boost the US soybean harvest and markets looked to stabilize after Friday’s plunge in corn prices.

top_signals.title: TotalEnergies Pledges More Price Cuts to Ease Diesel-Surge Pain
top_signals.summary: TotalEnergies SE will continue to bear down on pump prices in France through the current oil crisis, as it participates in a government-led release of strategic diesel reserves to further ease consumer costs, Chief Executive Officer Patrick Pouyanne said.
